title: Cowboy Chicken Recipe
reject_reason: Baked chicken breast with black beans, corn, fire-roasted tomatoes, green chiles and pepper jack is the same Tex-Mex chicken-bean bake as accepted tex-mex-baked-chicken (chicken + bake + Tex-Mex tomato + beans + cheese); corn/green-chile swap for enchilada sauce does not make a new dinner in an already Tex-Mex-skewed catalog.
